exposure: Peripartum period (3rd trimester vs. after delivery)
outcome: Left ventricular diastolic function (e', E/e' ratio)
Cardiac geometry (relative wall thickness, LV mass index)
cohort: The study included 397 pregnant women, with an average age of 33.7 years, who were evaluated via echocardiography during their 3rd trimester and within 4 days of delivery.
finding: Left ventricular diastolic function significantly decreased after delivery compared to the 3rd trimester, although it generally remained within the normal range.
cross-section timing: 3rd trimester (28-30 weeks' gestation) and within 4 days of delivery
